answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to a licensed seismic station bolted to bedrock below a named summit. The keeper logs every tremor at dawn and answers random signal checks by reading that exact station's live trace on camera within minutes, which one operator cannot do from two stations at once. The station fee in outside money doubles per further identity on the same funding trail, so each extra fake costs another real seismometer, another mountain posting, another live keeper, and twice the prior fee.
